feeds.note: USAJobs search API. NEEDS keys.json usajobs_key + usajobs_email - the person registers the free key at developer.usajobs.gov (onboarding phase 16, only when government jobs interest them). The API answers 401 without a key (verified 2026-10-11); idle until then. Same entry name in every pack so the assembler keeps one copy. organization VATA = Veterans Health Administration (drop the key to search all agencies).
